title: Ada Twist, Scientist
overview: Pint-sized scientist Ada Twist and her two best friends are asking big questions — and working together to discover the truth about everything!

title: Country Comfort
overview: When an up-and-coming young country singer accepts a job as a nanny with a musical family, she finds the bond she's always missed.

title: Erin & Aaron
overview: A newly blended family and two polar opposite stepsiblings named Erin and Aaron who come together through music.

title: Find Me in Paris
overview: When Lena Grisky, a Russian Princess and student at the Paris Opera Ballet School accidentally time travels to present day, she must quickly adapt if she hopes to keep her secret and hide from the dangerous Time Collectors.

title: Furry Friends Forever: Elmo Gets a Puppy
overview: An upcoming animated Sesame Street special premiering on HBO Max on August 5, 2021. The special serves as an introduction to Tango, Elmo's new pet puppy.

title: Go! Live Your Way
overview: Mia, a talented and courageous girl who lives with her adoptive godmother, earns a scholarship to attend the prestigious Saint Mary Academy, a school renowned for its acclaimed art department and privileged students. Once at Saint Mary, Mia tries to adapt to her new school but soon finds herself at odds with the owner’s daughter, the academy’s most talented and popular student. With the help of her two new friends, Mia sets out to win over Saint Mary, even capturing the attention of the school’s heartthrob and basketball player—the brother of her rival.

title: Julie and the Phantoms
overview: Teenage Julie finds her passion for music and life while helping the Phantoms -- a trio of ghostly guys -- become the band they were never able to be.

title: Karma’s World
overview: Talented singer and high school student Karma juggles rap dreams and rhyme schemes, using her talent, ambition and big heart to solve all kinds of problems.

title: Little Baby Bum: Music Time
overview: Come join the fun at the magical Music Time preschool, where every day is an adventure filled with kid-friendly songs — and lots of learning!

title: Sesame Street
overview: On a special inner city street, the inhabitants—human and muppet—teach preschoolers basic educational and social concepts using comedy, cartoons, games, and songs.

title: Sesame Street: The Nutcracker
overview: Featuring new music inspired by holiday classic The Nutcracker, this animated special follows Elmo’s fantastical adventure through magical lands to retrieve a nutcracker toy, along with his puppy Tango – who can speak for the first time!

title: StoryBots: Answer Time
overview: Got a question? The StoryBots have an answer! Join curious friends Beep, Boop, Bing, Bang and Bo on fun adventures to find facts for real kids like you.

title: Super Monsters
overview: Preschool kids whose parents are the world's most famous monsters try to master their special powers while preparing for kindergarten.

title: Trolls Holiday
overview: When the eternally optimistic Poppy, queen of the Trolls, learns that the Bergens no longer have any holidays on their calendar, she enlists the help of Branch and the rest of the gang on a delightfully quirky mission to fix something that the Bergens don't think is broken.

title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
overview: When something's wrong in the Rainbow Kingdom, bighearted guardian True and her best friend, Bartleby, are there to grant wishes and save the day.

title: The Magician's Elephant
overview: Peter is searching for his long-lost sister when he crosses paths with a fortune teller in the market square. His only question is: is his sister still alive? The answer, that he must find a mysterious elephant and the magician who will conjure it, sets Peter off on a journey to complete three seemingly impossible tasks that will change the face of his town forever.

title: Is It Cake? Halloween
overview: Cake or fake? Trick or treat? Skilled bakers whip up hyperrealistic Halloween cakes in this seasonal special edition of the hit competition series.

title: Scrooge: A Christmas Carol
overview: On a cold Christmas Eve, selfish miser Ebenezer Scrooge has one night left to face his past — and change the future — before time runs out.
